neighbours.label: the greeting in a spoken opening: Good morning, Buenos días, السلام
fire: "Good morning, doctor," the nurse said as she came in.
LA PRESIDENTA: Buenos días a todos y gracias por asistir.
He opened the door and called out, "Good morning everyone!"
EL MINISTRO: Buenas tardes y bienvenidos a la conferencia.
"Good evening, sir," said the waiter with a small bow.
السلام عليكم ورحمة الله، كيف حالكم اليوم؟
Hello and good afternoon, thanks for joining the call.
quiet: "The doctor is late," the nurse said as she came in.
LA PRESIDENTA: Los resultados son claros para todos.
هذا الكتاب جميل يا أصدقائي الكرام
He opened the door and called out, "Dinner is ready!"
EL MINISTRO: La conferencia termina a las cinco.
"The bill, sir," said the waiter with a small bow.
هذا اليوم حار جدا، أين ذهبتم اليوم؟
The call starts at three, so please be on time.
